_comment: WR-13: bootstrapped coverage baseline. The ratchet script (scripts/coverage_ratchet_check.py) hard-exits with code 2 if this file is missing, but no preceding CI step ever generated it — so every CI run on ubuntu-22.04 x Python 3.12 hard-failed at the 'Coverage ratchet check' step. This bootstrap uses the documented aspirational target of 65.23% (per pyproject.toml:391-392 comment 'Global coverage is 65.23%'). Run `python scripts/coverage_ratchet_check.py --regenerate` after a real pytest --cov run to lock in the actual current percentage as the new floor.
_source: bootstrapped from pyproject.toml documented aspirational target (65.23%)
